brief: 6 supplements I actually still take after 3 years of testing.

slots.headline: Which Supplements Actually Work?
slots.subtitle: Three years of testing. These six are still on my shelf.

slots.title: Magnesium Glycinate Daily
slots.body: I take this every night. It calms my nervous system and improves sleep quality without the laxative effect of other forms. Total game changer.

slots.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
slots.body: For brain fog and joint health. I look for high EPA with third-party testing. The difference in my focus is noticeable by noon.

slots.title: Vitamin D3 and K2
slots.body: Non-negotiable in winter months. The K2 directs calcium to bones instead of arteries. My levels finally stayed optimal year-round.

slots.title: Micronized Creatine Monohydrate
slots.body: Not just for gym bros. One scoop daily supports cognitive function and lean muscle. It is the most researched supplement for a reason.

slots.title: KSM-66 Ashwagandha Root
slots.body: I cycle this for stress management. It genuinely lowers my cortisol and takes the edge off busy weeks. Two months on, one month off.

slots.title: Methylated Vitamin B-Complex
slots.body: For energy metabolism and mood stability. The methylated forms absorb better, especially if you have MTHFR variants. I notice when I skip it.
